meta.subject: 영어독해와작문
meta.note: EBS·평가원 지문 변형, 학원 내부용. 1중간 기출패턴 기반.

questions.question:
다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

Over the past twenty years, with the arrival of digital politics, social and political protest movements have changed and become ever more prominent through what the sociologist Manuel Castells has called Networks of Outrage and Hope. ... While some suggest that these new politics are enhancing democracy, others maintain that they do not really challenge the dominant power groups. There seems a limit to the power of new social movements.
choices: ① the role of social media in spreading global news quickly
② how smartphones replaced traditional political party systems
③ the history of democratic revolutions in the twentieth century
④ why online activism always succeeds in toppling governments
⑤ both the rise and the inherent limits of digital protest movements
questions.explanation: 본문은 디지털 정치의 부상(more prominent)과 동시에 그 한계(There seems a limit to the power)를 함께 제시한다. 따라서 '부상과 내재적 한계 양면'을 담은 ⑤가 정답. ①'뉴스 확산'·③'20세기 혁명사'는 지엽/범위 밖, ②'정당 대체'·④'항상 정부 전복'은 본문에 없는 과장으로 오답.

questions.question:
다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

The dependent and shifting nature of art values ... committing himself to a painting is the collector's own act. Through it he courageously affirms not only his aesthetic judgment but the conviction that he can predict where art is going.
choices: ① The Collector's Bet: Affirming an Uncertain Future of Art
② Why Art Prices Always Rise Over Time
③ How Museums Decide Which Works to Preserve
④ Personal Enjoyment as the Only True Value of Art
⑤ The Decline of Consensus in Modern Art Criticism
questions.explanation: 예술 가치가 의존적·가변적이며 합의로 정해진다는 글. 수집가가 불확실한 가치에 '베팅'하듯 미적 판단을 단언한다는 ①(The Collector's Bet)이 핵심을 담아 정답. ②'예술 가격은 항상 오른다'·④'개인적 즐거움이 유일 기준'은 본문 논지와 어긋나는 과장, ③'미술관의 선정 방식'·⑤'합의의 쇠퇴'는 지엽·부분 키워드.

questions.question:
다음 도표의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
<Feelings of Isolation in Remote Work, by Age (%)>
Ageoftensometimesrarelynever
18–243834208
25–3429362510
35–4422333213
45+15304015
choices: ① 18–24세에서 'often'이 그 집단의 다른 어떤 응답보다 많았다.
③ 'rarely' 비율은 연령이 올라갈수록 20%→40%로 꾸준히 증가했다.
questions.explanation: 35-44 never=13%, 18-24 never=8% → 두 배(16%)가 아니므로 불일치.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

Living things are not confined to the familiar realm ①inhabited by plants ... most organisms are too small for us ③seeing without special equipment ... such as those ④used in breaking down waste ... ⑤have we begun to get a picture ...
questions.explanation: ③ too ~ to do 구문이므로 seeing → to see가 옳다(too small for us to see). ①inhabited는 realm을 수식하는 과거분사, ②because는 뒤에 절을 이끄는 접속사, ④used는 'be used to+동명사' 아닌 수동, ⑤have we begun은 부정어구 도치로 모두 적법.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

...depending on whether the information is conveyed ①intentionally or not ... may actually be ②interpreted as intentional ... is typically ③assumed to have communicative intent ... only ④informative to others. This shows that the meaning of an act is always ⑤identical across every cultural context.
questions.explanation: 문맥은 '문화마다 의미가 다름' → identical은 정반대.

questions.question:
다음 글에서 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 문장은?

...real-world clues offer the visitor a foothold onto the artist's oeuvre. ①Similarly, guests ... ②Together, these components affect particular experiences. ③The market value of a sculpture is determined primarily by the reputation of the auction house. ④Within the artist's studio ... ⑤By contrast, artworks displayed in exhibitions feel comparatively isolated ...
questions.explanation: 경매장 평판·시장가치는 '맥락이 의미를 부여한다'는 흐름과 무관.

questions.question:
What is the best meaning of the underlined expression, titrating how importantly people view their successes and failures, in the passage?

...By titrating how importantly people view their successes and failures, they can shape their emotional reactions ... that 'I am good.'
choices: ① measuring each success and failure against the same objective benchmark
② adjusting the perceived weight of outcomes to protect a positive self-image
③ recalling past achievements more vividly than past disappointments
④ weighing effort and luck equally when judging any single result
⑤ replacing emotional reactions to setbacks with detached, rational analysis
questions.explanation: titrate=(시약을 미세 조절하듯) 비중을 조절함. 성공은 무겁게·실패는 가볍게 '저울질'해 긍정적 자아상을 방어한다는 뜻이 정답 ②. ①은 '고정된 객관 기준'으로 정반대, ③'더 생생히 회상'·④'노력과 운을 동등하게'·⑤'감정을 이성으로 대체'는 모두 본문의 '비중 조절(편향적 가중)'과 어긋나는 매력적 오답.

questions.question:
글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?
[주어진문장] If you start to think too much about your driving, you actually increase your chances of having an accident.

...(①)...(②)... performed without explicit thinking. (③) Information appears to be perceived directly ... (④) People in sport competitions confirm that self-consciousness is one's worst enemy. (⑤)
questions.explanation: 주어진 문장(생각 과다→사고 위험)은 스포츠 자의식 언급 직전(④).

questions.question:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?
At the violin competition, my hands shook slightly as I stepped onto the stage. It had been years since I last performed on stage, and every eye in the room seemed fixed on me, pressing down with silent weight. I held the violin tightly, uncertain of how the first note would sound.

(A) I drew in a slow breath and raised the violin to my chin, anchoring it against my shoulder. The bow paused just above the strings, then touched down with purpose. My grip steadied, and with each movement that followed, I played Pachelbel's Canon in D ─ no longer hesitating, but sure and measured from the first note on.

(B) Then, as I looked down, the polished surface caught a faint reflection ─ my father's face, just as I remembered. In that moment, something settled.

(C) I thought of the quiet evenings when he sat beside me during practice, gently nodding in rhythm. His presence was steady and unwavering.
questions.explanation: 긴장 속 무대(주어진 글) → (B) 바이올린 표면에 비친 아버지 얼굴로 마음이 가라앉음(something settled) → (C) 연습 때 곁을 지킨 아버지 회상으로 그 안정감 부연 → (A) 숨을 고르고 연주를 시작하는 행동. 흐름상 (B)-(C)-(A).

questions.question: 윗글의 'I'에 관한 내용으로 적절하지 않은 것은? (9번 지문)
choices: ① 무대에 오를 때 손이 약간 떨렸다.
② 무대에서 연주한 지 여러 해가 지나 있었다.
③ 아버지는 연습 때 리듬에 맞춰 고개를 끄덕이곤 했다.
⑤ 바이올린 표면에서 어머니의 얼굴을 떠올렸다.
questions.explanation: 바이올린의 반짝이는 표면에 비친 것은 'my father's face'(아버지의 얼굴)이다. 어머니가 아니므로 ⑤가 일치하지 않는다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?
Along with the mistaken notion that the law resides in the books ①goes the equally mistaken idea that law is secret, or at least inaccessible to the ordinary person. To understand and apply the law at the technical level that lawyers do ②require professional knowledge, but to understand the basic substance of the law does not. Law reflects life. The principles ③embodied in the law are not different from those that we experience in other aspects of our lives. Contract law, for example, is a commentary on the way people make, interpret, keep, and ④break their promises in commercial and noncommercial settings. If you cross your fingers when you make a promise, does it mean that the promise doesn't count? If your newly purchased television doesn't work, can you return it to the store ⑤where you bought it? And so on.
questions.explanation: ② 주어가 To understand and apply the law(단수 취급)이므로 require → requires. ①goes는 'Along with ~ goes the notion'의 부사구 도치로 단수동사가 맞고, ③embodied는 명사를 뒤에서 수식하는 과거분사, ④break는 앞 동사와 병렬, ⑤where는 관계부사로 모두 적법.

questions.question:
윗글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
There are a growing number of AI tools that companies use to screen job applicants. These automated systems decide which smaller set of applicants from a large pool will reach a human hiring manager. The AI tool analyzes video interviews for content, word choice, facial expressions, and so on, assigning each interviewee an "employability score," which is compared to those of other applicants. But the validity of these tools is dubious; in fact, there is no evidence that these scores accurately predict job performance. Critics worry that algorithms trained on limited data will be more likely to give higher employability scores to typical applicants who are more frequently represented in the current workforce and give lower scores to those who appear atypical because they are less frequently represented in the current workforce. The result would be to reinforce current demographic imbalances instead of building a diverse workforce. Put differently, these automated technological tools seem to be reproducing biased wallpaper in hiring decisions. And, in fact, the technology may even be magnifying bias in new ways.
choices: ① the risk that AI hiring tools reproduce and even amplify existing bias
② how AI tools accurately measure job applicants' future performance
③ the growing popularity of video interviews among large companies
④ why human hiring managers should be replaced by automated systems
⑤ practical tips for applicants to raise their employability scores
questions.explanation: AI 채용 선별 도구가 타당성이 의심스럽고, 전형적 지원자에 유리하게 작동해 기존 인구통계학적 불균형을 강화하며 새로운 방식으로 편향을 증폭할 수 있다는 글. 따라서 주제는 ①(AI 채용 도구가 기존 편향을 재생산·증폭하는 위험).

questions.question:
윗글의 밑줄 친 (a)~(e) 중에서 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은? (12번 지문)
There are a growing number of AI tools that companies use to screen job applicants. These automated systems decide which smaller set of applicants from a large pool will reach a human hiring manager. The AI tool analyzes video interviews for content, word choice, facial expressions, and so on, assigning each interviewee an "employability score," which is compared to those of other applicants. But the validity of these tools is (a)<u>dubious</u>; in fact, there is no evidence that these scores accurately predict job performance. Critics worry that algorithms trained on limited data will be more likely to give (b)<u>higher</u> employability scores to typical applicants who are more frequently represented in the current workforce and give (c)<u>higher</u> scores to those who appear atypical because they are less frequently represented in the current workforce. The result would be to (d)<u>reinforce</u> current demographic imbalances instead of building a diverse workforce. Put differently, these automated technological tools seem to be reproducing biased wallpaper in hiring decisions. And, in fact, the technology may even be (e)<u>magnifying</u> bias in new ways.
questions.explanation: 비전형적(atypical) 지원자는 현재 노동력에서 덜 대표되므로 알고리즘이 '낮은(lower)' 점수를 준다는 맥락이다. (c) higher는 정반대이므로 lower가 되어야 한다. (a)dubious(타당성 의심), (b)higher(전형적 지원자엔 높은 점수), (d)reinforce(불균형 강화), (e)magnifying(편향 증폭)은 모두 적절.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고르면?

...all forms of standardized rankings ⓐinvolve figures ... by ⓑdefining different numerical categories ... certain numbers and figures, ⓒranged from ... when a quarterback ⓓis benched ... leagues in ⓔwhich participants select ... the participant ⓕwhose virtual team ... the most points ⓖwinning the jackpot.
questions.explanation: ⓒ ranged→ranging(능동분사), ⓖ winning→wins(절의 본동사). 모두 고르면 ⓒ,ⓖ.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절한 것은?

...observing their ①verbal behaviors such as ... vocal tone ... As it is easy to ②ignore nonverbal behavior ... we are ③gaining a lot of important information if we fail to attend to it ... if the lips are ④silent, one chatters with the fingertips. No wonder it is ⑤easy for most people to conceal what they mean ...
questions.explanation: 본문은 '비언어가 의미의 절반 이상을 전달한다'는 논지. ①verbal→nonverbal(비언어 behaviors), ③gaining→losing(주목 안 하면 정보를 잃음), ⑤easy→difficult(숨기기 어렵다)가 문맥상 오류. ②ignore는 '비언어를 무시하기 쉽다'로 자연스러워 함정. 적절한 것은 ④ silent(입이 침묵하면 손끝으로 말한다).

questions.question:
(A),(B),(C)의 각 네모 안에서 문맥에 맞는 낱말로 가장 적절한 것은?

...even seeing the word no ... will cause the brain to release dozens of (A)[stress-producing/tension-relieving] hormones. Conversely, positive words ... activate systems ... related to emotional (B)[regulation/disruption]. ... negative words ... have a more (C)[powerful/limited] effect on children ...
questions.explanation: (A) 부정어 no를 보기만 해도 뇌가 스트레스 호르몬을 분비 → stress-producing. (B) 그 호르몬이 정상적 뇌 기능(작동)을 방해 → 'regulation(조절)'을 방해한다가 문맥상 자연스러움(disruption을 넣으면 '방해를 방해'로 이중부정 오류). (C) 부정어의 효과가 강력함 → powerful. 따라서 ①. ②④는 (B)disruption, ③④는 (A)tension-relieving, ⑤는 (C)limited에서 각각 어긋나는 교차 함정.

questions.question:
밑줄 친 <u>"A chain is only as strong as its weakest link."</u>가 다음 글에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?
Without bark, a tree cannot transport sugar from its leaves to its roots. As the roots starve, they shut down their pumping mechanisms, and because water no longer flows through the trunk up to the crown, the whole tree dries out. However, many of the girdled trees continued to grow with more or less vigor. I now know that this was only possible with the help of intact neighboring trees. Thanks to the underground network, neighbors took over the disrupted task of provisioning the roots and thus made it possible for their buddies to survive. Some trees even managed to bridge the gap in their bark with new growth. I have learned from this just how powerful a community of trees can be. <u>"A chain is only as strong as its weakest link."</u> Trees could have come up with this old craftsperson's saying. And because they know this intuitively, they do not hesitate to help each other out.
choices: ① A forest thrives when its strongest trees are allowed to outgrow the rest.
② Neighboring trees compete fiercely for the same underground resources.
③ A single damaged tree rarely changes how the forest as a whole performs.
④ A tree community survives only when even its weakest members are kept alive.
⑤ The strongest trees must sacrifice their own growth to shield the weak.
questions.explanation: 환상박피로 약해진 나무도 이웃이 지하 네트워크로 양분을 보내 살린다는 글. '사슬은 가장 약한 고리만큼만 강하다'=군집은 가장 약한 구성원까지 살아 있을 때 강하다는 뜻이므로 ④가 적절. ①'강자 우위'·②'경쟁'·③'약한 나무 하나는 무영향'은 상부상조 논지와 반대, ⑤'강자의 희생'은 본문에 없는 과장으로 모두 함정.

questions.question:
다음 글에서 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 문장은?

Connectivity ... is of increasing concern for conservation biologists ... ①... barriers to movement ... ②Cities along river valleys ... eliminate genetic exchange ... ③Recent advances in highway engineering have dramatically reduced the cost of building new road networks ... ④... lack of connectivity can decrease the conservation value ... ⑤This increases the overall impact of habitat fragmentation.
questions.explanation: 글은 '인간에 의한 경관 변형이 다른 종의 이동(연결성)을 막아 서식지 단편화를 키운다'는 논지. ③'고속도로 공학 발전으로 도로 건설 비용이 크게 낮아졌다'는 건설비용 얘기로 연결성·단편화 논지와 무관. ①장벽화·②통행불가 사례·④보존가치 저하·⑤단편화 영향 증대는 모두 흐름에 부합.

questions.question:
Ache 부족에 관한 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

Hunters in the Ache tribe ... Instead of living by a philosophy of 'rugged individualism,' hunters who have a lucky day share their meat ...
choices: ① Ache 부족은 철저한 '강인한 개인주의' 철학에 따라 생활한다.
② 사냥의 성공 정도는 날마다 기복이 크다.
③ 잡은 고기를 혼자 쌓아 두면 상당 부분이 버려지게 된다.
④ 운이 좋은 날 사냥꾼은 다른 가족과 고기를 나눈다.
⑤ 자원 교환은 굶주림에 대한 상호 보험의 역할을 한다.
questions.explanation: 본문은 강인한 개인주의 '대신' 나눔 → ① 정반대(불일치).

questions.question:
글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?
[주어진문장] Since none of these people had visited savannas, the implication is that this preference was programmed into their brains.

People like pictures of the savanna ... (①) In one study ... (②) Eight-year-old children said ... (③) This programmed preference is called 'the savanna hypothesis.' (④) As people get older ... (⑤)
questions.explanation: 주어진 문장(가본 적 없음→각인된 선호)은 'savanna hypothesis' 명명 직전(③).

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

...fossil-fuelled power plants and hazardous-waste facilities are disproportionately and deliberately situated in Black or ethnic-minority neighbourhoods. As a result, the harm of environmental racism is not an accident of geography but ________________.
choices: ① a temporary side effect that fair housing policy has already corrected
② a structural pattern produced by where such facilities are intentionally placed
③ the inevitable outcome of individual lifestyle choices in poor areas
④ a problem largely confined to a few isolated industrial towns
⑤ a matter of personal health rather than community-wide exposure
questions.explanation: 'deliberately situated' → 지리적 우연이 아닌 의도적 배치의 구조적 패턴. ①④⑤ 부분키워드.

questions.question:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

Imagination continues to function when perception is not actively discerning objects, in cases of emotion, disease, and sleep.
(A) In such cases, a small similarity ... can lead to misidentification ...
(B) Emotions dispose one to see the world in a distorted way ...
(C) The more affected one is, the less similarity is required ...
questions.explanation: (B)감정 왜곡 도입 → (A)'In such cases' 오인 예시 → (C)정도 심화 일반화.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
When people are relieved of the cognitive load imposed by their environment, they immediately become more creative, neuroscientist Moshe Bar has found. Bar, who directs the Gonda Multidisciplinary Brain Research Center at Bar-Ilan University in Israel, reports that when he taxed subjects' mental resources as they completed a test of creative thinking, they came up with more "statistically common" (that is, conventional and commonplace) associations. In his study, Bar found that "a high mental load consistently diminished the originality and creativity" of his subjects' responses. His explanation: when our minds are otherwise occupied, we resort to mental shortcuts ─ convenient stereotypes, familiar assumptions, well-worn grooves. These are the thoughts that come most readily to mind, that take the least mental energy to generate. It requires ______ to inhibit these stale, reflexive responses and to reach beyond them for ideas that are fresher and more original.
choices: ② a relaxed and unoccupied mind
④ less mental energy than usual
questions.explanation: 인지 부하가 높으면 진부하고 반사적인 연상에 의존하게 되고, 그 반응을 억제하고 더 신선한 생각에 이르려면 오히려 '풍부한 인지적 자원(abundant cognitive resources)'이 필요하다는 흐름이다. 따라서 ①. ⑤(높은 정신적 부하)는 정반대.

questions.question:
다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

For thousands of years in the West, red was the only color worthy of that name ... It was with red that humans did their first color experiments ... and then constructed a chromatic universe.
choices: ① The Lost Art of Natural Dye Production
② How Modern Painters Rejected Traditional Color Codes
③ Why Color Terms Differ Across Every Language
④ The Scientific Discovery of the Visible Spectrum
⑤ Red: The First and Foremost Color in the Western World
questions.explanation: 서구에서 red가 최초이자 으뜸 색이었다.

questions.question:
글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?
[주어진문장] For example, expecting mothers who consume diets rich in healthy foods can help develop their child's taste preferences in a positive way.

...children naturally prefer ... sweet and salty ... (①) ... (②) ... sensory experiences ... can shape preferences ... (③) This is because flavors from foods that the mother eats are transmitted to amniotic fluid ... (④) ... (⑤)
questions.explanation: 주어진 예시(건강식 임산부)는 'This is because 양수·모유로 전달' 설명 앞(③).

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
As Michael Patrick Lynch observes in his book The Internet of Us: Knowing More and Understanding Less in the Age of Big Data, the information we derive from making correlations with big data often can be misleading unless we understand its context. He cites the example of a famous video map of cultural history that was created by using a data set of births and deaths of "notable" people over the past two thousand years. The shape and findings of the map were entirely dependent on the creators' assumptions of their data's parameters, including what constitutes a "notable" person. In other words, the answers we get are only as meaningful as ______. And for that, we need an understanding not just of correlations but of how and why the facts are so. Instead of seeing strands of information, we need to view the interconnected tapestry of relationships in a system. Thus, it is not enough to see that "culture" spread to different geographical hotspots in a particular pattern. We would need to study the social, economic, and political contexts. The purpose of data literacy, then, is to give us the tools to read the digital record and also to understand when we ought to look elsewhere.
choices: ① the sheer volume of data we are able to collect
② the speed at which we can process that data
③ the number of correlations the data reveals to us
⑤ the reputation of those who produced the data
questions.explanation: 빅데이터 지도의 모양과 결과가 제작자의 가정(누구를 '주목할 만한' 인물로 볼지)에 전적으로 의존했다는 예시의 재진술. 우리가 얻는 답은 '우리가 던지는 질문(the questions we frame)'만큼만 의미 있다는 ④가 정답. ③'상관관계의 수'는 바로 뒤 문장 '상관관계가 아니라 어떻게·왜인지 이해해야 한다'가 정면으로 부정하므로 가장 매력적인 함정. ①양·②속도·⑤제작자 평판은 글이 다루지 않는 표면 요소.
